description.en: Finds files by name inside archives: zip, 7z, rar, tar.gz and more. Type the name in the search box, or zip and a space for archives only. Only the lists of files are read, in the background; nothing is unpacked
description.zh: 按文件名找压缩包里的文件：zip、7z、rar、tar.gz 等。直接在搜索框里输入名字就能搜到，或输入 zip 加空格只看压缩包里的。后台只读文件列表，不解压

notes.zh: 新插件：按文件名找 zip、7z、rar、tar.gz 等压缩包里的文件，不用解压。直接搜，或输入 `zip 名字` 只看压缩包里的；Enter 打开压缩包，Ctrl+Enter 解压并打开这一个文件，Shift+Enter 打开所在文件夹。后台用最低的磁盘优先级只读文件列表，进度在插件卡片上，可以暂停。要 Win顺 0.47.0。权限：winshun:search（从 Win顺 的索引里拿到压缩包的列表）、读取文件（读压缩包的文件列表）。
notes.en: New plugin: finds files by name inside zip, 7z, rar, tar.gz and other archives, without unpacking. Just search, or type `zip name` for those alone; Enter opens the archive, Ctrl+Enter unpacks that one file and opens it, Shift+Enter shows its folder. Only the lists of files are read, in the background at the lowest disk priority; progress is on the plugin's card and can be paused. Needs WinShun 0.47.0. Permissions: winshun:search (the list of archives from WinShun's index), reading files (the archives' lists of files).
